description: The theme's Claude Code hooks (.claude/settings.json) run under Codex through .codex/hooks/claude-adapter.mjs; the .claude scripts stay the source of truth. Terminal: trust these once via /hooks (and again after any edit to this file). The xo-design panel runs them per thread with bypass_hook_trust. See .codex/README.md.

hooks.command: r="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$r/.codex/hooks/claude-adapter.mjs" ] && [ "$r" != / ]; do r="$(dirname "$r")"; done; node "$r/.codex/hooks/claude-adapter.mjs" .claude/hooks/skill-reminder.cjs
